title: Binary monic coefficient
statement: For a natural number $\ell$, let $m\in(\mathbb{Z}/2\mathbb{Z})^\ell$ and $d\in\mathbb{N}$. Define its monic coefficient at degree $d$ to be $m_d$ if $d<\ell$, $1$ if $d=\ell$, and $0$ if $d>\ell$.
hypotheses_covered: $m$ is a vector of length $\ell$ over $\mathbb{Z}/2\mathbb{Z}$
